notes: Numbers behind Figure 1 panels b and c (US-SRM, AU-How), computed over 7 common years (2010, 2011, 2012, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2022). AU-How's years are Jul-Jun Southern-Hemisphere season years (both calendar halves must be R2/N=14 passing years for AU-How, same rule as annual_inputs.csv/season_boundaries.csv) -- this is 7 years, not the 11 a naive calendar-label intersection of site_years.csv would give (which would wrongly include 2008/2017/2019/2024, whose following calendar year is not itself a passing year for AU-How). rep_year/rep_gsl_z17/rep_gsl_t95 = panel b's chosen year per site (closest to that site's own median Z17 GSL across the common years) and its Z17/T95 day counts. total_gpp/gpp_z17/gpp_t95 = panel c's three bars (GPP summed over all common years; gpp_z17/gpp_t95 = GPP on days above the Z17/T95 threshold only). gsl_z17_days/gsl_t95_days = summed day counts across the common years (panel c's bar labels).
